name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Position a preacher bench facing a low pulley and hold the bar palms up with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Lower it until your arms are nearly straight.
tips: Keep the backs of your upper arms in contact with the pad.
Stop just short of locking your elbows at the bottom to keep tension on your biceps.
